title: Neuro-Kurisu SUPER — weighted implementation roadmap and pass-completion scorecard — WorkPass61
method: Two percentages are tracked separately. WorkPass61 completion is DONE code deliverables divided by eight scoped implementation deliverables; checks are evidence, not progress items. Official weighted roadmap rises from 78.8% to 79.3% (+0.5 points): append-only authoritative provider-receipt revisions now preserve the original action/outcome fingerprint and canonical CognitiveEventFabric receipt trio, while a later provider receipt is attached as a separate superseding evidence revision. Real provider/device execution and restart E2E remain open, so this does not constitute release approval.

workstreams.name: Canonical source lineage and single-owner architecture
workstreams.rationale: Single writable organism state/memory authorities preserved. WorkPass39 adds a read-only cognitive ownership map and typed flow validation without parallel runtime state.

workstreams.name: Runtime integration, API/UI routes and smoke/linkage coverage
workstreams.rationale: Any structured API approvalRequired challenge can now pause the actual originating call, show a redacted preview and resume its captured JSON request exactly once after explicit approval. The cross-surface queue is now read-only to avoid conflicting approvals. Dependency-installed Vite and browser E2E remain open.

workstreams.name: Memory 2.0, retrieval/admission and benchmark evidence
workstreams.rationale: Memory admission now respects net utility, harm/redundancy and provenance even without budget pressure. Independent labelled temporal holdout remains open and retrieval uplift is still zero.

workstreams.name: Agency, action schema, execution, outcome and reafference
workstreams.rationale: WorkPass57 hardens outcome truth and delayed evidence correlation: external postcondition mismatch is distinct from success; inferred durable idempotency protects legacy mutation registrations; late observations survive bounded-index eviction/migration; learning credit now requires source provenance and independence. Simulated integrations pass; real provider/device postconditions and reconnect/replay remain open. WorkPass58 adds preflight across the complete reusable-skill candidate set and project tool path before partial execution/budget spend; real adapter E2E remains open. WorkPass59 closes the false-outcome/false-learning gap: non-execution gates are audit-only, skill/project competence updates require actual executor entry, and partial replay plus a blocked step is not treated as full replay. Real adapter postconditions and restart reconciliation remain open. WorkPass60 added versioned project-step checkpointing and reconciliation-first resume. WorkPass61 closes the code-level authoritative provider-found receipt conflict using append-only evidence revisions: base execution/outcome fingerprint and original action/outcome/evidence event IDs remain immutable; receipt replay is idempotent, changed content conflicts, and revision refs persist through snapshots/migration. Real provider/device postconditions, actual process restart and live receipt semantics remain unverified.

workstreams.name: Portable subject continuity and social/known-entity dossier
workstreams.rationale: Unified cycle verification is tied to actual same-tick causal edges; this improves continuity evidence but is not a claim of subjective consciousness.

workstreams.name: External transport, SDK, idempotency and replay
workstreams.rationale: Stable IDs for new evidence and legacy ID continuity are improved; external transport delivery receipts/reconnect and multi-provider reconciliation remain open. WorkPass58 stops external HTTP callers from self-asserting autonomous provenance and keeps normalized decision identity across approval/resume; live transport validation remains open. WorkPass60 resumes unresolved work through read-only provider reconciliation and retains the exact operation identity while blocking changed payloads. Real provider receipt finalization and multi-provider transport validation remain open. WorkPass61 maps authoritative provider-found outcomes to a separate persisted evidence-revision record and CognitiveEventFabric reconciliation event without replaying the side effect or rewriting the original receipt trace. Real multi-provider delivery, live receipts and device transport recovery remain open.

workstreams.name: Research promotion and controlled experiments
workstreams.rationale: WorkPass40 reviews the existing source archives and upstream contracts, adds SBOM/provenance inventory, and adapts the documented OpenAI-compatible llama.cpp endpoint into the existing P40 model ecology. External source clones and target-hardware inference remain pending where network or target hardware is unavailable.

workstreams.name: Release durability: build, E2E, rollback, soak, SBOM/provenance
workstreams.rationale: WorkPass57 aligns root/runtime pass metadata, expands architecture audit to cross-package source imports, and passes source hygiene, integrity, syntax, receipt and recovery checks. Installed Vite/browser E2E, live provider/device validation, clean-room rollback, manual nested-source license sign-off and soak remain open. WorkPass58 aligns root/runtime release metadata and current-pass docs; root metadata contract and final packaged archive are revalidated before delivery, while actual release gates remain open. WorkPass60 adds scoped restart/reconciliation regression tests and release metadata, but production browser/device validation, clean-room rollback and soak are still open. WorkPass61 regenerates runtime release/architecture/archive manifests and synchronizes the current scorecard; this does not close production build, browser/device E2E, rollback or soak gates.
